purpose: Prespecified extension of public-spending proof of concept, before primary forest fitting/scoring has completed
selection: Unused test-partition OCIDs after the complete primary selection; whole procedures, chunks of at least 32 awards, at least two positive eligible groups; never use training/calibration source procedures
conditions: redistribution of 1% of smaller target group total
redistribution of 10% of smaller target group total
redistribution of 50% of smaller target group total
models: Reuse numerically identical primary fitted/calibrated models for profile versions 1.1 and 1.2, seed 7; verify bundle fingerprints against primary report. No tuning.
strong_baseline: R_group computes exact grouped conservation against the independently filtered source using Arrow and EquiFrame compare_grouped; compare with R_global, M, MAD and hybrids. Do not interpret gains over incomplete R_global as superiority over comprehensive known rules.
uncertainty: Bootstrap whole source chunks including all five paired variants; engine repetitions and severity variants do not inflate independent sample size.
trace: Reconstruct paths and score on the first selected source at each fixed severity, without selecting examples by favorable decisions.
timing: Primary pass costs are observational while other QA jobs run. A later isolated repeated measurement must distinguish M-only API, profile, rule and full comparison; do not claim H3 from joint M+B timing.
outcomes: Report unfavorable or null outcomes and blind spots; do not describe controlled defects as actual misconduct or real source corruption.
